sentences.zh: 她说她一直接到当地店主和工人的电话，其中一些人自枪击事件发生以来就没怎么休息过。

sentences.en: A lot of them were here the night of the incident.
sentences.zh: 他们很多人事发当晚就在这里。

sentences.en: They haven't had any reSt.
sentences.zh: 他们根本没法休息。

sentences.en: They're suffering.
sentences.zh: 他们正在受苦。

sentences.en: This whole demonstration and counter-demonstration and gathering and all the news cameras was just too much.
sentences.zh: 整个示威、反示威、集会以及所有的摄像机镜头，实在是太过分了。

sentences.en: And it was making it worse.
sentences.zh: 而且这让情况变得更糟。

sentences.en: And the police major's like, you have a right to be here.
sentences.zh: 那位警察少校说，你们有权待在这里。

sentences.en: You have a right to say what you want to say.
sentences.zh: 你们有权说你们想说的话。

sentences.en: But out of respect for my community, I'm just asking for a favor.
sentences.zh: 但出于对我社区的尊重，我请求你们帮个忙。

sentences.en: If you guys can just take it down the street, away from this business.
sentences.zh: 如果你们能移步到街那边，远离这家店。

sentences.en: But removed from the rawness of this pain.
sentences.zh: 远离这种痛苦的创伤。

sentences.en: And pretty much everybody stayed put.
sentences.zh: 结果几乎所有人都待在原地没动。

sentences.en: So what happens when the president finally arrives?
sentences.zh: 那么当总统最终到达时会发生什么呢？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So he lands in the morning, gets in a motorcade.
sentences.zh: 他早上降落，坐上车队。

sentences.en: He goes to a hospital that treated some of the victims the night of the shooting.
sentences.zh: 他去了枪击当晚收治部分受害者的医院。

sentences.en: And he meets with the victims there.
sentences.zh: 他在那里会见了受害者。

sentences.en: He meets with a large group of first responders.
sentences.zh: 他会见了一大群急救人员。

sentences.en: And he met with some of Ohio's political leaders.
sentences.zh: 他还与俄亥俄州的一些政治领导人见了面。

sentences.en: And then he got in his motorcade and flew to El Paso.
sentences.zh: 然后他坐上车队飞往埃尔帕索。

sentences.en: So he did not go to the Oregon District where people like Ken had gone to pay their respects and where they had hoped to see the president at the site of the
sentences.zh: 所以他没有去俄勒冈区，那里是像肯这样的人去表达敬意的地方，也是他们希望在枪击现场看到总统，

sentences.en: shooting and to be able to talk to him?
sentences.zh: 并能与他交谈的地方？

sentences.en: He did not.
sentences.zh: 他没去。

sentences.en: There were people there to protest him if he did.
sentences.zh: 如果他去了，那里会有抗议他的人。

sentences.en: There were people there to cheer him if he came.
sentences.zh: 如果他来了，那里也会有为他欢呼的人。

sentences.en: There were people like Ken who just wanted the chance to talk to him.
sentences.zh: 那里有像肯这样只想有机会和他谈谈的人。

sentences.en: He didn't go there.
sentences.zh: 他没去那里。

sentences.en: The mayor actually said that may have been a wise decision.
sentences.zh: 市长实际上说这可能是一个明智的决定。

sentences.en: That was one she supported that, judging from the reaction of the vigil on Sunday, people there maybe weren't ready or didn't want to have the president be present there.
sentences.zh: 她支持这一点，因为从周日守夜活动的反应来看，那里的人们可能还没准备好，或者不想让总统出现在那里。

sentences.en: Mitch, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 米奇，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我。

sentences.en: After the break, my colleague Natalie Kichoeff on the scene in El Paso.
sentences.zh: 休息之后，我的同事娜塔莉·基乔夫将从埃尔帕索现场发回报道。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月，而且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间越过付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Michael Crowley, you cover the White House and you're in El Paso now.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·克劳利，你负责报道白宫，现在你在埃尔帕索。

sentences.en: Help us understand what's been happening in the days since the shooting there.
sentences.zh: 帮我们了解一下枪击事件发生后的几天里发生了什么。

sentences.en: El Paso, from what happened in Dayton, is that first of all, the other and I think more politically
sentences.zh: 埃尔帕索的情况，从代顿发生的事情来看，首先，另一个我认为在政治上更具

sentences.en: explosive factor is that minutes before the shooting here, a manifesto was posted online that may indicate a motive in the attack.
sentences.zh: 爆炸性的因素是，在枪击发生前几分钟，网上发布了一份宣言，这可能表明了袭击的动机。

sentences.en: And it is a manifesto that is anti-immigrant and clearly raciSt. And it also echoes many of the things, and in some cases, the very language that President
sentences.zh: 这是一份反移民且明显种族主义的宣言。它还呼应了许多观点，在某些情况下，甚至直接使用了特朗普总统

sentences.en: Trump has used for months and years in his clampdown on illegal immigration and beef up borders.
sentences.zh: 多年来在打击非法移民和加强边境管控时所使用的语言。

sentences.en: In El Paso, in particular, there was a real sense that he bears culpability for what happened and that he was essentially not welcome.
sentences.zh: 特别是在埃尔帕索，人们有一种强烈的感觉，即他对所发生的事情负有责任，而且他本质上是不受欢迎的。

sentences.en: President Trump called me yesterday.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统昨天给我打了电话。

sentences.en: He was very gracious in the call.
sentences.zh: 他在通话中非常有礼貌。

sentences.en: The mayor of El Paso, while saying that he would receive President Trump and basically saying that
sentences.zh: 埃尔帕索市长虽然表示他会接待特朗普总统，并基本表示

sentences.en: he had an inherent respect for the office of the presidency, did not at all make it clear that he was looking forward to having him here or indeed that he was welcome.
sentences.zh: 他对总统职位有一种内在的尊重，但完全没有表现出他期待总统到来，或者总统确实受欢迎。

sentences.en: And I want to clarify for the political spin that this is the office of the mayor of El Paso
sentences.zh: 我想澄清一下，从政治角度来看，这是埃尔帕索市长办公室

sentences.en: in an official capacity, welcoming the office of the president of the United States, which I consider is my formal duty.
sentences.zh: 以官方身份欢迎美国总统办公室，我认为这是我的正式职责。

sentences.en: So it sounds like things were pretty fraught before Trump even touched down.
sentences.zh: 听起来在特朗普抵达之前，局势就已经相当紧张了。

sentences.en: Extremely fraught.
sentences.zh: 极其紧张。

sentences.en: You've been very clear that you believe the president is a raciSt. Is the president a white supremacist?
sentences.zh: 你一直很明确地认为总统是种族主义者。总统是白人至上主义者吗？

sentences.en: He is.
sentences.zh: 他是。

sentences.en: He's also made that very clear.
sentences.zh: 他也把这一点表达得很清楚。

sentences.en: He's Beto O'Rourke, a former congressman from El Paso, who is now running for president,
sentences.zh: 他是贝托·奥罗克，一位来自埃尔帕索的前国会议员，现在正在竞选总统，

sentences.en: did several interviews after the shooting in which he explicitly called President Trump a raciSt.
sentences.zh: 他在枪击事件后接受了几次采访，明确称特朗普总统为种族主义者。

sentences.en: Connect the dots about what he's been doing in this country.
sentences.zh: 把他在这个国家所做的事情联系起来看看。

sentences.en: He's not tolerating racism.
sentences.zh: 他不是在容忍种族主义。

sentences.en: He's promoting racism.
sentences.zh: 他是在助长种族主义。

sentences.en: He's not tolerating violence.
sentences.zh: 他不是在容忍暴力。

sentences.en: He's inciting racism and violence in this country.
sentences.zh: 他是在这个国家煽动种族主义和暴力。

sentences.en: And said that Mr. Trump had no business coming to El Paso.
sentences.zh: 并表示特朗普先生根本不该来埃尔帕索。

sentences.en: And Donald Trump, as he often does, counterattacked on Twitter.
sentences.zh: 而唐纳德·特朗普像往常一样，在推特上进行了反击。

sentences.en: The president tweeting O'Rourke has a phony name to indicate Hispanic heritage.
sentences.zh: 总统发推文说奥罗克有一个虚假的名字，用来暗示西班牙裔血统。

sentences.en: Made fun of his name and told him to be quiet.
sentences.zh: 嘲笑他的名字并叫他闭嘴。

sentences.en: O'Rourke firing back in a tweet of his own saying,
sentences.zh: 奥罗克在自己的推文中回击道：

sentences.en: 22 people in my hometown are dead after an act of terror inspired by your racism.
sentences.zh: 在我家乡，22人在你种族主义煽动的恐怖行径后丧生。

sentences.en: El Paso will not be quiet and neither will I.
sentences.zh: 埃尔帕索不会沉默，我也不会。

sentences.en: So what does it feel like on the ground there?
sentences.zh: 那么当地的感觉如何？

sentences.en: I'm at the scene of Saturday's shooting.
sentences.zh: 我正在周六枪击事件的现场。

sentences.en: The first thing I did this morning was to go to the memorial site.
sentences.zh: 今天早上我做的第一件事就是去纪念地。

sentences.en: Where there are dozens of people gathered in the heat,
sentences.zh: 那里聚集了数十人在酷暑中，

sentences.en: leaving memorials, putting up signs, candles, balloons, tributes to the victiMs.
sentences.zh: 留下纪念品，摆放标语、蜡烛、气球，向受害者致敬。

sentences.en: And I see a woman named Rosemary Rojas.
sentences.zh: 我看到了一位名叫罗斯玛丽·罗哈斯的女士。

sentences.en: My age is, I'm a grandmother.
sentences.zh: 我的年龄是，我是一位祖母。

sentences.en: That's my age.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的年龄。

sentences.en: Who described herself as a political and social activiSt.
sentences.zh: 她形容自己是一位政治和社会活动家。

sentences.en: I got a call that morning from my granddaughter.
sentences.zh: 那天早上我接到了孙女的电话。

sentences.en: And she had two family members who were at the time of the shooting.
sentences.zh: 她有两个家人在枪击发生时在场。

sentences.en: She told me that my son and my other granddaughter were in the Walmart and they were able to escape through the tire department.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，我的儿子和另一个孙女当时在沃尔玛，他们设法从轮胎部门逃了出来。

sentences.en: Including the granddaughter, who she said is still quite drunk.
sentences.zh: 包括那个孙女，她说她现在还处于极度惊恐中。

sentences.en: He hears a sound like keys dropping on the floor.
sentences.zh: 他听到像钥匙掉在地板上的声音。

sentences.en: So President Trump is on his way here.
sentences.zh: 所以特朗普总统正在来这里的路上。

sentences.en: He'll be here in a couple of hours.
sentences.zh: 他几个小时后就会到。

sentences.en: And I wondered whether you think that's a helpful and useful thing for the president to come visit.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你是否认为总统来访是有帮助和有益的。

sentences.en: For not my president to come here and visit is an insult to the people that have suffered these tremendous oppressive conditions.
sentences.zh: 对于非我所选的总统来说，来这里访问是对那些遭受了巨大压迫条件的人们的侮辱。

sentences.en: Not only is it an insult to us, we see him as him coming to bathe in the glory of this bloodbath that his rhetoric has created.
sentences.zh: 这不仅是对我们的侮辱，我们认为他来这里是为了沐浴在他的言论所造成的血腥屠杀的荣耀中。

sentences.en: And I'm telling you right now that he is not welcome here.
sentences.zh: 我现在告诉你，他不欢迎来到这里。

sentences.en: We don't want him here.
sentences.zh: 我们不希望他来。

sentences.en: His words are empty to us.
sentences.zh: 他的话对我们来说是空洞的。

sentences.en: Would you mind by starting out telling me your name, age, and where you're from?
sentences.zh: 你介意先告诉我你的名字、年龄和来自哪里吗？

sentences.en: My name is Adolfo Tejas.
sentences.zh: 我叫阿道夫·特哈斯。

sentences.en: I happen to be chairman of the Republican Party in El Paso County.
sentences.zh: 我恰好是埃尔帕索县共和党的主席。

sentences.en: On the other side, I spoke to a man named Adolfo Tejas.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，我采访了一位名叫阿道夫·特哈斯的男士。

sentences.en: He is a local Republican official.
sentences.zh: 他是一位当地的共和党官员。

sentences.en: And he is a supporter of President Trump who thinks that it's a good thing that the president is coming here.
sentences.zh: 他是特朗普总统的支持者，认为总统来这里是一件好事。

sentences.en: He believes the president has said the right thing in the wake of the shooting.
sentences.zh: 他认为总统在枪击事件后说了正确的话。

sentences.en: I thought he had some very good remarks.
sentences.zh: 我认为他发表了一些非常好的言论。

sentences.en: And he talked about it.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了这一点。

sentences.en: You know, it's time for us to come together and heal together.
sentences.zh: 你知道，现在是我们团结起来共同疗伤的时候了。

sentences.en: And has no problem with the president coming to try to console and comfort the city.
sentences.zh: 而且他对于总统来试图安抚和慰问这座城市没有任何意见。

sentences.en: The fact that he's here in El Paso, the fact that he's supporting the people that were hurt, who are a lot of Hispanics,
sentences.zh: 他来到埃尔帕索的事实，他支持那些受伤的人（其中很多是西班牙裔）的事实，

sentences.en: and the fact that he's visiting with law enforcement, because it was a carnage.
sentences.zh: 以及他正在会见执法部门的事实，因为那是一场大屠杀。

sentences.en: And for law enforcement to see that, that's going to have an impact on them also, plus the rest of the community.
sentences.zh: 对于执法人员来说，看到这一点，这对他们以及社区的其他成员也会产生影响。

sentences.en: I mean, it's positive that he's here to let us know that we've got the White House here to support us in what we need.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他在这里让我们知道白宫在这里支持我们的需求，这是积极的。

sentences.en: And that's a very positive thing.
sentences.zh: 这是一件非常积极的事情。

sentences.en: Actually, while I was interviewing Adolfo...
sentences.zh: 事实上，当我在采访阿道夫时……

sentences.en: Sorry to interrupt you.
sentences.zh: 抱歉打断你。

sentences.en: It seems like something's kind of bubbling up over there.
sentences.zh: 那边好像有什么事情正在酝酿。

sentences.en: Do you have any idea why people are arguing?
sentences.zh: 你知道人们为什么在争吵吗？

sentences.en: You know, all of a sudden I started to hear shouting and chanting, and I could see that the crowd had sort of condensed.
sentences.zh: 你知道，突然之间我开始听到叫喊声和口号声，我可以看到人群似乎聚集起来了。

sentences.en: It looks like a chant has come up, and state troopers arrived, so...
sentences.zh: 看起来有人在喊口号，州警也到了，所以……

sentences.en: And when I went over to see what was happening, I saw that the crowd had gathered around a woman.
sentences.zh: 当我走过去看发生了什么时，我看到人群围住了一位女士。

sentences.en: I see a woman in a red Make America Great Again hat, who is surrounded by TV cameras and seems very upset.
sentences.zh: 我看到一位戴着红色“让美国再次伟大”帽子的女士，她被电视摄像机包围着，看起来非常不安。

sentences.en: People were shouting at this woman.
sentences.zh: 人们在对这位女士大喊大叫。

sentences.en: There was profanity.
sentences.zh: 有脏话。

sentences.en: There were exchanges of name-calling.
sentences.zh: 还有互相辱骂的争执。

sentences.en: It was getting really tense.
sentences.zh: 气氛变得非常紧张。

sentences.en: And then this guy shows up, basically to defend this woman and engage the people who were shouting her down.
sentences.zh: 然后这个家伙出现了，基本上是为了保护这位女士并与那些大喊大叫的人对峙。

sentences.en: And he's giving right back at the people who were angry at this woman, and he is shouting right back at them.
sentences.zh: 他正在回击那些对这位女士感到愤怒的人，他也在对他们大喊大叫。

sentences.en: People now are calling him a white supremacist, and he is defiantly right in the middle of this scrum.
sentences.zh: 人们现在称他为白人至上主义者，而他确实正处于这场争执的中心。

sentences.en: The woman actually disappeared from my view, and this guy, who was quite large and sort of athletic-looking,
sentences.zh: 那个女人实际上从我的视野中消失了，而这个家伙，他身材相当魁梧，看起来有点像运动员，

sentences.en: was in shouting matches with multiple people before really storming away in anger.
sentences.zh: 在真正愤怒地冲走之前，曾与多个人发生过激烈的争吵。

sentences.en: And I sort of chased him down and caught up with him.
sentences.zh: 我算是追上了他，并赶上了他。

sentences.en: Can I get you for two minutes?
sentences.zh: 能占用你两分钟时间吗？

sentences.en: Can you tell me your name, age, and where you're from?
sentences.zh: 能告诉我你的名字、年龄以及你是哪里人吗？

sentences.en: Sean Bryan.
sentences.zh: 肖恩·布莱恩。

sentences.en: Man, I'm from here.
sentences.zh: 伙计，我就是本地人。

sentences.en: And what brought you here today, to this site?
sentences.zh: 是什么让你今天来到这个地方？

sentences.en: I've been coming by every morning.
sentences.zh: 我每天早上都会过来。

sentences.en: I was at the mall when the whole thing went down.
sentences.zh: 事情发生的时候，我正好在商场。

sentences.en: I'm a United States Marine, or a retired Marine.
sentences.zh: 我是美国海军陆战队队员，或者说退役海军陆战队员。

sentences.en: And I've been wanting to just watch it.
sentences.zh: 我一直想来看看。

sentences.en: Just take it in, not forget it.
sentences.zh: 只是感受一下，不要忘记它。

sentences.en: So are you finding when you come here, are there a lot of people arguing?
sentences.zh: 那你来这里的时候，有没有发现很多人在争吵？

sentences.en: You know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: Today's the first time I've seen any of that.
sentences.zh: 今天是我第一次看到这种情况。

sentences.en: Every day I've been here, it's been nice and quiet and peaceful.
sentences.zh: 我来这里的每一天，这里都很安静、祥和。

sentences.en: You know, clearly these guys thought that they could bully that girl, and they need to start caring for Americans.
sentences.zh: 你知道，显然这些人认为他们可以欺负那个女孩，他们需要开始关心美国人了。

sentences.en: I don't care if you're Democrat, Republican, Independent, black, white, yellow, polka-dotted.
sentences.zh: 我不在乎你是民主党人、共和党人、独立人士，还是黑人、白人、黄种人，或者是波点肤色。

sentences.en: I don't give a shit.
sentences.zh: 我根本不在乎。

sentences.en: You're an American, you're an American.
sentences.zh: 你是美国人，你就是美国人。

sentences.en: We need to all stick together, and we need to all look out for each other.
sentences.zh: 我们都需要团结一致，我们都需要互相照顾。

sentences.en: Clearly, people are really on edge.
sentences.zh: 显然，人们现在非常紧张。

sentences.en: People are really on edge, and it feels like there is simmering tension, and any kind of spark, even one Make America Great Again hat, can light the fire.
sentences.zh: 人们确实非常紧张，感觉有一种暗流涌动的紧张气氛，任何一点火星，哪怕是一顶“让美国再次伟大”的帽子，都可能点燃战火。

sentences.en: And when Trump arrives in El Paso in the afternoon, what happens?
sentences.zh: 当特朗普下午抵达埃尔帕索时，发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, Trump had a pretty low-profile arrival here and didn't talk to reporters.
sentences.zh: 嗯，特朗普在这里的抵达相当低调，没有与记者交谈。

sentences.en: He went to the medical center here, and he met with some of the survivors and the hospital staff there.
sentences.zh: 他去了当地的医疗中心，会见了那里的幸存者和医院工作人员。

sentences.en: Mr. Trump then went on to a police facility, an emergency response center, where reporters were allowed in.
sentences.zh: 特朗普先生随后前往一个警察设施，一个应急响应中心，记者们被允许进入。

sentences.en: And at that point, he made his first—he left the White House this morning.
sentences.zh: 在那一点上，他进行了他第一次——他今天早上离开了白宫。

sentences.en: As you know, we left Ohio, and the love, the respect for the office of the presidency,
sentences.zh: 如你所知，我们离开了俄亥俄州，那种爱，那种对总统职位的尊重，

sentences.en: it was—I wish you could have been in there to see it.
sentences.zh: 那是——我真希望你能在那儿亲眼看看。

sentences.en: I wish you could have been in there.
sentences.zh: 我真希望你能在那儿。

sentences.en: And what did he say?
sentences.zh: 他说了些什么？

sentences.en: He claimed that the day had been a big success, that he had been received with a lot of respect in Ohio, and that things had been going very well.
sentences.zh: 他声称这一天非常成功，他在俄亥俄州受到了极大的尊重，事情进展得非常顺利。

sentences.en: We met with numerous people.
sentences.zh: 我们见到了许多人。

sentences.en: We met with also the doctors, the nurses, the medical staff.
sentences.zh: 我们还见到了医生、护士和医务人员。

sentences.en: They have done an incredible job.
sentences.zh: 他们做得非常出色。

sentences.en: Both places, just incredible.
sentences.zh: 两个地方，都非常出色。

sentences.en: And, you know, for a moment, it seemed as though he was going to play the kind of traditional,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，有一瞬间，看起来他似乎要扮演那种传统的、

sentences.en: apolitical role of a president coming to a, you know, a disaster area or a place that had been struck by tragedy.
sentences.zh: 非政治性的总统角色，来到一个遭受灾难或悲剧袭击的地方。

sentences.en: I had it with Sherrod Brown, he and the mayor, Nan Wally.
sentences.zh: 我和谢罗德·布朗谈过，还有他和市长南·沃利。

sentences.en: This is Donald Trump, and although his aides had hoped that he would stay on a pretty tight script today,
sentences.zh: 这就是唐纳德·特朗普，尽管他的助手们曾希望他今天能严格按照稿子来，

sentences.en: he began to lash out.
sentences.zh: 但他开始猛烈抨击。

sentences.en: I turn on the television, and then they are saying, well, I don't know if it was appropriate for the president to be here, you know, et cetera, et cetera,
sentences.zh: 我打开电视，然后他们说，嗯，我不知道总统来这里是否合适，你知道，等等等等，

sentences.en: you know, the same old line.
sentences.zh: 你知道，还是那一套老调重弹。

sentences.en: They're very dishonest people, and that's probably why he got, I think, about zero percent that he failed as a presidential candidate.
sentences.zh: 他们是非常不诚实的人，这可能就是为什么他作为总统候选人失败时，我想他只得到了大约零的选票。

sentences.en: We're going to go in and see some very great people.
sentences.zh: 我们要进去见一些非常伟大的人。

sentences.en: And he attacked Democrats who he felt had been critical of him in Ohio, including Democratic Senator Sherrod Brown and also former Vice President Joe Biden,
sentences.zh: 他抨击了那些他认为在俄亥俄州批评过他的民主党人，包括民主党参议员谢罗德·布朗，以及前副总统乔·拜登，

sentences.en: who had given a speech saying that President Trump was sort of fomenting racial hatred around the country.
sentences.zh: 后者曾发表讲话称特朗普总统在全国范围内煽动种族仇恨。

sentences.en: And he accused them of politicking on a day when he said there should not have been politics and took personal shots at them both.
sentences.zh: 他指责他们在不该谈论政治的日子里搞政治，并对他们两人进行了人身攻击。

sentences.en: So that was not how things were supposed to go here today.
sentences.zh: 所以今天这里的情况本不该是这样的。

sentences.en: But that is Donald Trump in the role of president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 但这就是作为美国总统的唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: Michael, it seems clear from that meeting with reporters and from your conversations in El Paso
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，从那次与记者的会面以及你在埃尔帕索的谈话来看，似乎很清楚，

sentences.en: that this has not been anything like a traditional presidential visit to a city that has undergone a tragedy.
sentences.zh: 这与传统的总统访问遭受悲剧的城市完全不同。

sentences.en: No, that's absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 不，这绝对正确。

sentences.en: You know, a tradition was shaped over generations in which at times of tragedy...
sentences.zh: 你知道，一种传统在几代人中形成，在悲剧发生时……

sentences.en: To the people of the community of Littleton,
sentences.zh: 对于利特尔顿社区的人民，

sentences.en: I can only say tonight that the prayers of the American people are with you.
sentences.zh: 我今晚只能说，美国人民的祈祷与你们同在。

sentences.en: An American president would visit communities that were in the midst of collective grief.
sentences.zh: 一位美国总统会访问那些处于集体悲痛中的社区。

sentences.en: This is a day of mourning for the Virginia Tech community.
sentences.zh: 今天是弗吉尼亚理工大学社区的哀悼日。

sentences.en: And it is a day of sadness for our entire nation.
sentences.zh: 这对我们整个国家来说都是悲伤的一天。

sentences.en: And act as a kind of consoler.
sentences.zh: 并扮演一种安慰者的角色。

sentences.en: Try to unite.
sentences.zh: 试图团结。

sentences.en: Try to heal.
sentences.zh: 试图治愈。

sentences.en: Here in Newtown, I come to offer the love and prayers of a nation.
sentences.zh: 在纽敦，我来这里是为了献上一个国家的爱与祈祷。

sentences.en: Try to reassure people with the, you know, kind of almost mystical powers of the office and the resources of the federal government.
sentences.zh: 试图用总统职位那种近乎神秘的力量和联邦政府的资源来安抚人们。

sentences.en: And people would hit pause on politics for a day.
sentences.zh: 人们会暂停政治一天。

sentences.en: And you must know that whatever measure of comfort we can provide, we will provide.
sentences.zh: 你们必须知道，无论我们能提供多少安慰，我们都会提供。

sentences.en: Whatever portion of sadness that we can share with you to ease this heavy load,
sentences.zh: 无论我们能分担多少悲伤来减轻这沉重的负担，

sentences.en: we will gladly bear it.
sentences.zh: 我们都乐意承担。

sentences.en: We're interested in those.
sentences.zh: 我们对这些很感兴趣。

sentences.en: See, he basically never hits pause on his attack politics.
sentences.zh: 你看，他基本上从不暂停他的攻击性政治。

sentences.en: So we are in a very different place right now.
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在处于一个非常不同的境地。

sentences.en: And one question is whether we can return from it.
sentences.zh: 一个问题是我们是否还能回得去。

sentences.en: And at the same time, this problem just keeps getting worse.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，这个问题只会变得越来越糟。

sentences.en: These mass shootings are coming on the heels of mass shootings.
sentences.zh: 这些大规模枪击事件接二连三地发生。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it's not clear that we are closer to any kind of substantive action to address it than we were a week ago.
sentences.zh: 而且不清楚我们是否比一周前更接近任何实质性的行动来解决这个问题。

sentences.en: Well, President Trump did say this morning that he thought that there might be some action in Congress.
sentences.zh: 嗯，特朗普总统今天早上确实说他认为国会可能会有一些行动。

sentences.en: He suggested that it could involve checks for gun sales.
sentences.zh: 他暗示这可能涉及枪支销售的背景调查。

sentences.en: But he said things like that before and not followed through and not much has happened.
sentences.zh: 但他以前也说过类似的话，却没有付诸行动，也没发生什么事。

sentences.en: And the Republican agenda to address these shootings is very different from the Democratic one.
sentences.zh: 而共和党解决这些枪击事件的议程与民主党的非常不同。

sentences.en: Democrats think that we need to have sweeping new gun control measures.
sentences.zh: 民主党人认为我们需要采取全面且新的枪支管制措施。

sentences.en: And Republicans are talking about mental health and even video games and the Internet.
sentences.zh: 而共和党人则在谈论心理健康，甚至电子游戏和互联网。

sentences.en: It's almost like they're speaking different languages.
sentences.zh: 这简直就像他们在说不同的语言。

sentences.en: So it's hard to see any kind of solution on the horizon.
sentences.zh: 所以很难看到任何解决方案出现在地平线上。

sentences.en: And, you know, it's terrible to say, but it just feels like the clock is ticking to the next one of these.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，说出来很可怕，但感觉就像是在为下一次枪击事件倒计时。

sentences.en: Michael, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for having me.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你邀请我。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, Puerto Rico's Supreme Court threw its government into new turmoil by ruling that the island's latest governor was unlawfully sworn in.
sentences.zh: 周三，波多黎各最高法院裁定该岛最新任总督宣誓就职不合法，使政府陷入新的动荡。

sentences.en: The new governor, Pedro Pierlusi, was the hand-picked successor of former governor Ricardo Rosseo,
sentences.zh: 新任总督佩德罗·皮尔路易西是前总督里卡多·罗塞略亲自挑选的继任者，

sentences.en: who resigned amid mass protests over leaked text messages in which Rosseo mocked his own citizens.
sentences.zh: 后者因泄露的短信中嘲笑本国公民而引发大规模抗议，最终辞职。

sentences.en: The court ruled that Pierlusi had never been properly confirmed to his last position as Puerto Rico's secretary of state, making him ineligible to become its governor.
sentences.zh: 法院裁定，皮尔路易西从未正式确认其作为波多黎各国务卿的最后一个职位，这使他没有资格担任总督。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周在《Wirecutter秀》中，我们正准备迎接节假日的客人。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何地方收听《Wirecutter秀》。
